verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Foreloop acting as an MCP server that external clients connect to (an endpoint URL plus an API key). Nothing shows Foreloop itself registering or consuming third-party MCP servers to use their tools. Server-side MCP is a different role and earns no credit for this client-side story, and the axis is fair for a platform that runs its own agents, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
